metadata.spec: Example: Build a chat application similar to claude.ai

features.description: User can see the main chat interface on load
steps: Navigate to application URL
Verify main chat area is visible
Verify welcome message or empty state is displayed
Verify sidebar is visible (collapsed or expanded)

features.description: User can type a message in the input field
steps: Click or tab to input field
Type text characters
Verify text appears in input field
Verify cursor position is correct
Verify input accepts multi-line text (Shift+Enter)

features.description: User can send message by pressing Enter
steps: Type a message in input field
Press Enter key (without Shift)
Verify message appears in chat history
Verify input field is cleared after sending
Verify scroll position moves to bottom

features.description: User can see AI response streaming
steps: Send a message
Verify loading indicator appears
Verify AI response streams in word-by-word or token-by-token
Verify streaming completes with full response
Verify loading indicator disappears after completion
features.notes: Streaming implemented but occasional stutter on long responses - needs optimization

features.description: User can send message by clicking Send button
steps: Type a message in input field
Click the Send button icon
Verify message is sent (same behavior as Enter key)
Verify button has visual feedback on click
Verify button is disabled when input is empty

features.description: Sidebar shows list of past conversations
steps: Open or expand sidebar
Verify list of past conversations is displayed
Verify conversations are sorted by date (newest first)
Verify conversation titles are truncated if too long
Verify active conversation is highlighted

features.description: User can click conversation to load it
steps: Click on a past conversation in sidebar
Verify conversation loads in main chat area
Verify all messages are displayed
Verify clicked conversation is highlighted as active
Verify scroll position is at bottom (latest message)

features.description: User can create new chat from sidebar
steps: Click 'New Chat' button in sidebar
Verify current conversation is saved
Verify chat area clears to welcome state
Verify new conversation is created in backend
Verify sidebar shows new conversation at top
Right-click or hover on conversation in sidebar
Select 'Rename' option
Enter new name in input field
Press Enter or click Save
Verify conversation title updates in sidebar
Right-click or hover on conversation in sidebar
Select 'Delete' option
Verify confirmation dialog appears
Click 'Confirm' in dialog
Verify conversation is removed from sidebar
Verify chat area shows next conversation or welcome state

features.description: User messages display with correct styling
steps: Send a message
Verify user message appears on right side
Verify user message has distinct background color
Verify timestamp is displayed
Verify message has avatar or initial

features.description: AI messages display with correct styling
steps: Receive an AI response
Verify AI message appears on left side
Verify AI message has distinct background color
Verify timestamp is displayed
Verify AI avatar or logo is shown
Hover over any message
Verify copy button appears
Click copy button
Verify content is copied to clipboard
Verify visual feedback (toast or icon change) confirms copy
Hover over an AI message
Verify regenerate button appears
Click regenerate button
Verify previous response is replaced
Verify new response streams in
Verify user can cycle through previous versions
Open settings menu
Find theme/appearance toggle
Click to switch to dark mode
Verify entire UI switches to dark colors
Click to switch to light mode
Verify entire UI switches to light colors
Verify preference persists across page reload
